name: TiDB
model: Tables of rows with SQL, speaking the MySQL protocol and dialect; optional columnar replicas (TiFlash) for analytics on the same data
engine_note: Stateless SQL layer over TiKV, a key-value store on RocksDB (LSM) split into Raft-replicated regions; TiFlash keeps columnar copies
consistency: Multi-row, cross-node transactions. Default is snapshot isolation, labelled repeatable read for MySQL compatibility; read committed is an option (pessimistic mode only); no serializable. Writes commit through Raft majorities. Stale reads and follower reads are opt-in.

jepsen.finding: Default automatic transaction retries broke snapshot isolation, allowing read skew and lost updates; retries disabled by default from 3.0.0-rc.2, after which tests passed.

scaling: Automatic sharding by key range into regions that split and rebalance as you add TiKV nodes; scale SQL nodes and columnar TiFlash nodes separately.
version_note: 8.5 is the newest LTS line; 7.5.8 (2026-09-17) is a later patch to the older 7.5 LTS. No 9.x appears in the release timeline as of 2026-10-04.
reach: Reach for it when a MySQL app outgrows one primary and you want automatic sharding plus analytics on fresh data without a separate warehouse.
avoid: Avoid when you need serializable isolation, a small single-node footprint, or exact MySQL behaviour for every feature.
escape: You leave the Postgres default for this because writes outgrow one machine and the app speaks MySQL.
chat: Messages and usage events for a large MySQL-based chat product, with dashboards on the same data via TiFlash.
notes: Isolation facts quoted from the TiDB isolation levels page (2026-10-04). Release lines from the TiDB release timeline page.
